steps.text: Finish Rag and Bone Man I.
Enter the hole to the Lumbridge Swamp caves.
Enter the hole to the Lumbridge Swamp caves.
Kill bats south of the Odd Old Man.
Kill undead cows west of the Ectofuntus.
Enter the Experiment Cave near Castle Fenkenstrain.
Kill the citizens/werewolves in Canifis. (Do not use Wolfbane)
Go down into Varrock Sewer via the Manhole south east of Varrock Castle.
Kill Moss Giants near the entrance.
Kill Cave Goblins in the east of the Lumbridge Caves. Run between the marked tiles to avoid the Wall Beasts.
Kill desert snakes north of Nardah.
Kill the giant lizards north of Nardah.
Kill vultures south west of Nardah.
Kill seagulls on the Port Sarim docks.
Enter the Asgarnia Dungeon by Mudskipper Point.
Kill Ice Giants at the end of the dungeon.
Throw a fishing explosive to attract a Mogre on Mudskipper Point.
Kill fire giants deep in the dungeon.
Go to Taverley Dungeon. Bring an antifire shield if you can.
Go to Taverley Dungeon. Bring a dusty key if you have one, otherwise you can get one in the dungeon. Bring an antifire shield if you can.
Travel through Taverley Dungeon until you reach the Black Knights' Base. Kill the Jailer in the east side of the base for a jail key.
Use the jail key on the south door and talk to Velrak for a dusty key.
choices: So... do you know anywhere good to explore?

steps.text: Enter the gate to the deeper Taverley dungeon.
Kill baby blue dragons. South east near the lava is a good spot without any adult dragons.
Enter the cave north east of Rellekka.
Kill bunnies south east of Rellekka.
Kill basilisks in the middle of the dungeon.
Kill Terrorbirds in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

items.name: Inoculation bracelet or a potion for Disease

steps.text: Buy 27 jugs of vinegar from Fortunato in Draynor Village, then use them on pots.
Use the bones on the pots of vinegar.
Place logs under the pot-boiler near the Odd Old Man. If you've already polished all the bones, hand them in to the Odd Old Man.
Add a bone to the pot boiler.
Light the logs under the pot-boiler.
Wait for the bones to be cleaned. You can hop worlds to make this happen instantly.
Take the pot from the pot-boiler.
Give the Odd Old Man the bones.
Talk to the Odd Old Man to finish.
Repeat the steps until all the bones are cleaned.
